title: Geometric Spiral Abstraction
description: An abstract painting on a black textured background featuring a central orange circle surrounded by concentric teal and black rings intersected by thin geometric wires. Vibrant pink, yellow, blue, and purple triangles, along with dynamic black brushstrokes and paint drips, radiate outward in a dynamic composition.
